headline: U.S. Jury Finds Huawei Guilty of Deceiving Banks About Its Business in Iran
summary: A federal jury in Brooklyn found Chinese telecom equipment maker Huawei guilty of 10 of the 12 criminal charges it faced, including deceiving banks about its business in Iran.
why: Huawei is a major global supplier of telecom networks and devices, and US sanctions and export-control cases against it affect its access to Western markets and suppliers.
original_headline: Jurado de EU declara culpable a Huawei de engañar a bancos sobre sus negocios en Irán
